edits.text: Before calling cancel_reservation, check if any flight in the reservation has already been flown (i.e., its date is before the current date). If it has, do not call cancel_reservation and transfer the user to a human agent.
edits.reason: The agent failed to check if a flight was in the past before canceling, which is a policy requirement for transferring to a human.

edits.text: When the user asks to add a number of bags, calculate total_baggages as the current total_baggages plus the number the user wants to add (not any total number mentioned in a summary), and nonfree_baggages as the number of bags in excess of the free allowance (minimum 0).
edits.reason: The agent incorrectly used a total baggage number from a summary instead of the quantity the user requested to add.

edits.text: When the user asks for the cheapest flight option (even if it has a stop), the agent must call both search_direct_flight and search_onestop_flight to compare the prices of all available flights.
edits.reason: The agent failed to compare both direct and one-stop flights when asked to find the cheapest option.
